patterns.note: Sections primarily use a dark (black or very dark grey) background with contrasting light text, creating a sophisticated and high-contrast visual experience.
Extremely large, outlined sans-serif typography is used as decorative section titles, providing a strong visual anchor and editorial feel.
The primary color scheme is monochromatic, relying heavily on black, white, and various shades of grey, with vibrant imagery providing the only bursts of color.
Content sections and large outlined text elements reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they scroll into the viewport.
Content is presented in full-bleed hero images followed by structured grids of images with concise text descriptions, often interspersed with large typographic statements.

technique_notes: To rebuild the dark theme, use a pure black or near-black background for most sections, with white or very light grey for primary text and subtle off-white for secondary text or borders.
The large outlined text effect can be achieved by applying a text stroke to a large, bold sans-serif font, ensuring the fill color is transparent or matches the background for the outline effect.

The motion system involves a sticky header that remains fixed at the top of the viewport. Content sections and specific large text elements are animated to fade and slide upwards into view as they enter the user's scrollable area, creating a dynamic reveal effect.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) are used for hero sections, while body text is clean and legible. Extremely large, outlined sans-serif text serves as decorative section titles.
design_tokens.radius: sharp, with very subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with airy hero sections and generous padding around content blocks, creating a sense of luxury and openness.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold and minimalist dark aesthetic, which is powerfully contrasted by the use of extremely large, outlined sans-serif typography as decorative section titles. This combination creates an editorial, high-fashion feel that elevates the brand beyond typical automotive marketing.
